Step 1: 1106 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic calendar).  
Step 2: Subtract 327 days from 1106-11-25.  
Go back 25 days to 1106-10-31.  
Remaining: 327 − 25 = 302 days.  
Step 3: Subtract month-by-month from October 31, 1106:  
September (30 days) → 302 − 30 = 272, date becomes 1106-10-01.  
August (31) → 272 − 31 = 241, date becomes 1106-08-31.  
July (31) → 241 − 31 = 210, date becomes 1106-07-31.  
June (30) → 210 − 30 = 180, date becomes 1106-06-01.  
May (31) → 180 − 31 = 149, date becomes 1106-05-01.  
April (30) → 149 − 30 = 119, date becomes 1106-04-01.  
March (31) → 119 − 31 = 88, date becomes 1106-03-01.  
February (28) → 88 − 28 = 60, date becomes 1106-01-31.  
January (31) → 60 − 31 = 29, date becomes 1105-12-31.  
Step 4: Remaining 29 days: go back into December 1105:  
December 31 − 29 days = 1105-12-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1105-12-02
